name: Washed (Wet Process)
description: Removes the fruit layer before drying to emphasize transparency, acidity, and terroir clarity.
flavorImpact: Typically clean, bright, and floral with a transparent cup structure.

name: Natural (Dry Process)
description: Coffee is dried inside the whole cherry, allowing sugars and fruit compounds to infuse the seed during drying.
flavorImpact: Typically fruity, winey, and heavier bodied than washed coffees.

name: Yellow Honey
description: Around 25% mucilage is retained during drying for a lightly sweet, approachable honey profile.
flavorImpact: Sweet and mild with more roundness than fully washed coffees.

name: Red Honey
description: About 50% mucilage retention increases sweetness and fruit expression while preserving clarity.
flavorImpact: Sweeter and fruitier than yellow honey with balanced body.

name: Black Honey
description: Roughly 75-100% mucilage is left on the parchment and dried slowly for maximum sugar concentration.
flavorImpact: Intense sweetness, dense body, and jammy complexity.

name: White Honey
description: Minimal mucilage retention produces the cleanest and most delicate expression within honey processing.
flavorImpact: Cleanest honey profile with gentle sweetness and light body.

name: Anaerobic Natural
description: Whole cherries ferment in oxygen-free tanks before drying as naturals.
flavorImpact: Can create intense fruit, lactic complexity, and controlled funk.

name: Anaerobic Washed
description: Depulped coffee undergoes oxygen-free fermentation before being washed and dried.
flavorImpact: Adds enhanced complexity to a washed framework while retaining clarity.

name: Double Anaerobic
description: Two distinct anaerobic fermentation stages are applied to push aromatic intensity and texture.
flavorImpact: Extreme complexity with layered fermentation character and dense sweetness.

name: Carbonic Maceration
description: Whole cherries ferment in a CO2-rich atmosphere to encourage juicy esters and aromatic lift.
flavorImpact: Often tropical, candy-like, and perfumed with vivid fruit character.

name: Extended Fermentation Washed
description: Washed coffees fermented for roughly 60-120 hours before final rinsing and drying.
flavorImpact: Adds depth and complexity to a clean washed cup profile.

name: Semi-Washed (Pulped Natural)
description: Coffee is partially depulped and dried with some mucilage retained, bridging washed and natural styles.
flavorImpact: Balanced sweetness with moderate body and preserved clarity.
